subject: Nordic Bank: Hosting & data residency — next steps and routing clarification
summary: Post-demo qualification follow-up to confirm whether Nordic Bank can use Redwood hosted EU endpoints vs Dedicated/Private VPC for Finnish data residency and cross-region routing fallback. Captures two follow-up asks and proposed next steps including a technical workshop and PO outline.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Korhonen <elena.korhonen@nordicbank.fi>, Nordic Bank Procurement <procurement@nordicbank.fi>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 12:15:00 +0100
Subject: Recap & next steps — hosting, residency, and routing (post-demo)

Hi Elena / Procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciate the clear questions from your Cloud Ops and Procurement folks. Quick recap from our side and three small asks so we can align on the right hosting mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).

Recap (short):
- Primary requirement: all customer PII and transaction metadata for production must remain within Finland or EU-controlled infrastructure for regulatory review.
- Secondary requirement: low-latency traffic to APAC test regions for a small subset of internal services (non-PII) with clear documented cross-border fallback behavior.
- Preference: keep integration simple if Hosted EU endpoints meet residency + audit needs; otherwise explore Dedicated capacity in an EU-only configuration or Private VPC (Azure Finland/Sweden region) if contractually required.

Asks / next steps:
1) Elena, can you confirm whether "data residency in Finland" must be strictly Finnish-region hosting, or whether EU-only (e.g., Frankfurt/Stockholm) is acceptable for production?
2) If Finnish-region strictness is required, Procurement please confirm if an NDA/contract amendment is allowable to enable Private VPC pricing.
3) Proposed next step from Redwood: technical workshop with your Cloud Ops and our Solutions Engineering to map flows and define which objects must never leave Finland. Can we schedule 60 mins next week?

Attachments: deployment-options-summary.pdf (short table of tradeoffs), nordicbank-region-map.png (illustrative), eu-hosting-sla-table.xlsx (SLA and latency expectations).

If easier, I can loop in our Compliance lead — but wanted to keep this email focused.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +44 20 8123 4567

From: Elena Korhonen <elena.korhonen@nordicbank.fi>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nordic Bank Procurement <procurement@nordicbank.fi>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — hosting, residency, and routing (post-demo)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Residency: Our legal team prefers that production customer data (PII + certain transaction metadata) remain in Finland. EU-only (DE/SE) is acceptable only for non-PII telemetry or for pre-production.
- Cross-region fallback: For the APAC test traffic you saw, we need documented guarantees that PII will never egress to APAC. Non-PII can be routed for testing, but with opt-in toggles.
- Procurement: We typically require a separate SOW/addendum for any Private VPC or on-prem work and will need estimated monthly cost and required lead time.

Yes to the 60-min workshop — can you propose times? Also please include an outline of what Redwood needs from us (logs, sample schema, traffic volumes).

Best,

Elena Korhonen
Head of Cloud Operations | Nordic Bank
elena.korhonen@nordicbank.fi

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Korhonen <elena.korhonen@nordicbank.fi>, Nordic Bank Procurement <procurement@nordicbank@nordicbank.fi>
Date: Sat, 7 Feb 2026 10:20:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — hosting, residency, and routing (post-demo)

Jonas / Ben — internal note to align technical framing before the workshop. Please keep as internal until we confirm wording for the customer.

Key mapping:
- Option A — Hosted EU (recommended first step): Redwood-hosted endpoints in an EU region (Frankfurt / Stockholm). Pros: fastest time-to-value, no infra commitments. Cons: does not satisfy strict "Finland-only" contractual residency. Mitigations: per-tenant data partitions + audit logs; however legal still may flag this.
- Option B — Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools, EU-only): Pros: dedicated tenancy, can be configured to block egress to APAC. Cons: minimum commit and slower provisioning (2–4 weeks).
- Option C — Private VPC / On-prem: Pros: full control, can run in Finland region (Azure Finland/Sweden or local data center). Cons: integration overhead, higher setup cost and separate contract + estimated 6–10 week lead time for full delivery (including KMS/HSM and audit wiring).

Ask for the workshop: we'll need:
- Network diagram (what touches PII),
- Sample throughput and token volume per hour (production and peak),
- Any regulatory audit checklist (GDPR specifics that mention physical geofencing).

I'll draft a slide with the three-option decision matrix and a rough ballpark of timing/costs to share with Elena prior to the workshop.

Aisha Rahman
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Korhonen <elena.korhonen@nordicbank.fi>, Nordic Bank Procurement <procurement@nordicbank@nordicbank.fi>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 14:40:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — hosting, residency, and routing (post-demo)

Hi Elena / Procurement,

Thanks — great clarifications. Proposed concrete next steps:

1) Schedule the 60-min technical workshop next Wednesday 2026-02-17 at 10:00 CET (I can shift if needed). Attendees suggested: Elena, one engineer from Cloud Ops, Procurement rep, Aisha, Ben, and me. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

2) Prep pack from Nordic Bank (requested): a one-page network/data flow diagram that flags PII buckets, and a short spreadsheet with estimated token/event volume per hour (prod and peak). If you can share by 2026-02-13 that gives us time to prepare.

3) Procurement: I'll attach a separate zip with a Private VPC SOW template and a ballpark cost sheet. If Nordic Bank prefers to explore Hosted EU first (to avoid a separate contract), we will prepare an elevated audit note that spells out residual risk and compensating controls for your legal team.

I attached deployment-options-summary.pdf and eu-hosting-sla-table.xlsx again for quick reference. If this plan looks good I'll send the invite and a short pre-read for the workshop.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +44 20 8123 4567

- deployment-options-summary.pdf (table: Hosted EU / Dedicated EU-only / Private VPC with pros/cons, lead times, rough cost bands)
